decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that fits the firm's stated direction, core curing capabilities, and a growing market, it is likely to stay unless results are clearly disappointing.

This organic snack is close to the established assortment and supported by the firm's expansion into organic products, though as a less central single line it faces somewhat more performance uncertainty.

The premium sharing snack line matches the firm's broad charcuterie range and uses familiar resources, so with industry growth and some organisational slack the firm would likely continue it while monitoring sales.
